- Task ID:
- Work order: `docs/work_orders/工单/<TASK-ID>.md`
- Review record: `docs/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md`

- 用户可见变化：

## 验证

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run build:offline`
- [ ] `npm run test:offline`
- [ ] 宽屏视觉检查（如适用）
- [ ] 窄屏视觉检查（如适用）
- [ ] 未提交生成物、秘密或本机配置

## 主审结论

- [ ] `docs/reviews/<TASK-ID>.md` 为 `APPROVED`
- [ ] 审查提交 SHA 与当前 HEAD 一致
